"""Read-only production review; only disposable cache fixtures are mutated."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
from evaluate_context import prepare_cases
from prove_context_delivery import inspect_delivery
from pacer_mcp.pages import assemble_context_pages, context_page
from pacer_mcp.semantics import canonical
from pacer_mcp.service import Service

OUT = Path(__file__).parent / uuid4().hex[:8]
OUT.mkdir()
report = {"passed": False, "model_calls": 0, "checks": {}, "source_sha256": {}}
for relative in ["plugins/pacer/src/pacer_mcp/pages.py", "plugins/pacer/src/pacer_mcp/service.py", "scripts/prove_context_delivery.py"]:
    report["source_sha256"][relative] = hashlib.sha256((ROOT / relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def collect(packet, max_bytes=2048):
    pages, cursor = [], ""
    while True:
        page = context_page(packet, cursor=cursor, max_bytes=max_bytes)
        assert len(canonical(page).encode()) <= max_bytes
        pages.append(json.loads(canonical(page)))
        cursor = page["next_cursor"]
        if not cursor:
            return pages

def refused(label, operation):
    try:
        operation()
    except ValueError as exc:
        report["checks"][label] = {"passed": True, "refusal": str(exc)}
    else:
        raise AssertionError(label + " unexpectedly accepted")

def event(tool, arguments, payload):
    return {"type": "item.completed", "item": {"type": "mcp_tool_call", "server": "pacer", "tool": tool, "arguments": arguments, "status": "completed", "result": {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": canonical(payload)}], "structured_content": payload}}}

try:
    rng = random.Random(712)
    started = time.monotonic()
    for index in range(80):
        value = "".join(rng.choice(["\U0001f600", "\u8def", "\\", '"', "\n", "a", "\u0301"]) for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 12000)))
        packet = {"task": "PAC-001", "complete": True, "payload": {"a": [value, {}, [], True, None, 0], "b": [index, ""]}, "receipt": {"basis": "a" * 64, "task": "PAC-001", "root": "x"}}
        pages = collect(packet, rng.choice([2048, 2049, 3072, 8000, 32000]))
        assert assemble_context_pages(pages) == packet
    report["checks"]["random_roundtrips"] = {"passed": True, "cases": 80, "seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)}

    prepare_cases(OUT / "fixtures")
    service = Service(OUT / "fixtures/current")
    packet = service.context("PAC-001", max_bytes=1000000)
    root = packet["receipt"]["root"]
    pages = collect(packet)
    assert len(pages) >= 2
    state = service.onboard()
    events = [event("pacer_onboard", {"root": root}, state)]
    cursor = ""
    for page in pages:
        events.append(event("pacer_context_page", {"root": root, "id": "PAC-001", "cursor": cursor, "max_bytes": 2048}, page))
        cursor = page["next_cursor"]
    write_args = {"root": root, "actor": "native-delivery", "revision": state["revision"], "onboarding": state["onboarding"], "context": packet["receipt"], "operations": [{"op": "checkpoint", "id": "PAC-001", "next_action": "verify"}]}
    read_events = deepcopy(events)
    result = service.apply(write_args["operations"], actor=write_args["actor"], revision=write_args["revision"], onboarding=write_args["onboarding"], context=write_args["context"])
    events.append(event("pacer_apply", write_args, result))
    report["checks"]["native_evaluator_positive_control"] = {"passed": True, "result": inspect_delivery(events, packet, checkpoint=True)}
    report["checks"]["native_evaluator_readonly_control"] = {"passed": True, "result": inspect_delivery(read_events, packet, checkpoint=False)}
    mutations = {}
    mutations["missing_onboard"] = deepcopy(events[1:])
    for label, position, field, value in [("wrong_root", 1, "root", root + "other"), ("wrong_task", 1, "id", "PAC-999"), ("wrong_budget", 1, "max_bytes", 4096), ("wrong_actor", -1, "actor", "other"), ("wrong_revision", -1, "revision", "0" * 64), ("wrong_onboarding", -1, "onboarding", "0" * 64), ("wrong_receipt", -1, "context", {"basis": "0" * 64}), ("skipped_cursor", 2, "cursor", "")]:
        bad = deepcopy(events)
        bad[position]["item"]["arguments"][field] = value
        mutations[label] = bad
    mutations["extra_shell"] = deepcopy(events) + [{"type": "item.completed", "item": {"type": "command_execution", "status": "completed"}}]
    mutations["extra_mcp"] = deepcopy(events) + [event("pacer_context", {"root": root}, packet)]
    mutations["early_write"] = [deepcopy(events[0]), deepcopy(events[-1]), *deepcopy(events[1:-1])]
    for label, bad in mutations.items():
        refused("evaluator_" + label, lambda bad=bad: inspect_delivery(bad, packet, checkpoint=True))
    refused("evaluator_readonly_write", lambda: inspect_delivery(events, packet, checkpoint=False))

    for label, bad in [("missing_final", pages[:-1]), ("reordered", list(reversed(pages))), ("duplicate", [pages[0], *pages])]:
        refused("assembler_" + label, lambda bad=bad: assemble_context_pages(bad))
    bad = deepcopy(pages)
    bad[-1]["receipt"]["basis"] = "0" * 64
    refused("assembler_tampered_receipt", lambda: assemble_context_pages(bad))
    for size in [2047, 32001, True, 2048.0]:
        refused("invalid_page_budget_" + str(size), lambda size=size: context_page(packet, max_bytes=size))

    # Continue a real stream through different interpreter processes/hash seeds.
    command = [sys.executable, "-m", "pacer_mcp.cli", "--root", root, "context-page", "PAC-001", "--max-bytes", "2048"]
    wire, cursor = [], ""
    for index in range(20):
        env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONHASHSEED=str(index + 101))
        completed = subprocess.run(command + (["--cursor", cursor] if cursor else []), capture_output=True, check=True, env=env)
        page = json.loads(completed.stdout)
        wire.append(page)
        cursor = page["next_cursor"]
        if not cursor:
            break
    assert not cursor
    assert assemble_context_pages(wire) == service.context("PAC-001", max_bytes=1000000)
    report["checks"]["cross_process_continuation"] = {"passed": True, "processes": len(wire)}

    (Path(root) / "settings.json").write_text('{"retries":0}', encoding="utf-8")
    assert service.evaluate("OGM-001")["result"] == "FAIL"
    refused("changed_source_cursor", lambda: service.context_page("PAC-001", cursor=wire[0]["next_cursor"], max_bytes=2048))
    report["checks"]["demonstrated_regression"] = {"passed": True, "rule": service.evaluate("OGM-001")["result"]}

    for fields in [["Context", "Instructions", "ValidationCriteria", "ExpectedOutput"], ["ErrorHandling", "DependencyReason", "UnblockingStrategy", "Title"]]:
        state = service.onboard()
        receipt = service.context("PAC-001", max_bytes=1000000)["receipt"]
        service.apply([{"op": "set", "id": "PAC-001", "fields": {key: "x" * 125000 for key in fields}}], actor="review-limit", revision=state["revision"], onboarding=state["onboarding"], context=receipt)
    oversize = service.context("PAC-001", max_bytes=1000000)
    assert not oversize["complete"] and oversize["receipt"] is None
    refused("oversize_page", lambda: service.context_page("PAC-001", max_bytes=2048))
    report["checks"]["packet_limit"] = {"passed": True, "required_bytes": oversize["required_bytes"], "receipt": oversize["receipt"]}
    report["passed"] = True
except Exception as exc:
    report["error"] = repr(exc)
    raise
finally:
    (OUT / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"passed": report["passed"], "checks": len(report["checks"]), "report": str(OUT / "report.json")}))
